verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies bulk capability. The Code Mode MCP server exposes the entire Cloudflare API through search() and execute(), so an agent can script operations across many resources. Queues, Workflows and cron jobs support fan-out batch processing, and event subscriptions mention 'a Workers AI batch request being queued'. No source explicitly documents bulk or batch operations across many items for users or agents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk/batch APIs or commands (e.g., bulk KV/DNS/resource operations via Wrangler or MCP), a worked example of an agent performing a multi-item operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
